description: ECS Task Definition Environment Variable Contains a Potential Secret
rationale: A container in an ACTIVE task definition has a literal environment value that matches a credential format or a literal value in a variable named like a password, secret, token or key. Task definition environment values are readable with ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition and are kept in every revision. Values supplied through secrets[] (Secrets Manager/SSM references) are not flagged. The report shows only container, variable name, detection type and a masked preview. Malformed definitions are UNKNOWN.
remediation: Move the value to the container definition's secrets[] using Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store, rotate the exposed credential, register a new revision and deregister revisions that contain the literal value.
